note: Annual election of one councillor in each of the 15 wards of Belfast Corporation (the member retiring in rotation), nominations Thursday 5 January, poll Monday 16 January 1933. After John Kennedy withdrew in St George's, ten members were returned unopposed and five wards were contested; the Unionists gained Dock from Labour and lost Shankill to Robert Hill of the Corporation Tenants' Association (Belfast News-Letter, 6, 7 and 17 January 1933). Mrs. Coleman, the retiring member, was the only woman on the Council; Pierce, a brother of Alderman Pierce, stood as an Independent Unionist (News-Letter, 6 January).
